class.name: MediaSource
class.brief_description: Reads a media file (Matroska/WebM, MP4/MOV, MPEG-TS, AVI) with FFmpeg: video access units for a hardware decoder, decoded audio for an [AudioStreamMedia].
class.description: Opens a file with FFmpeg's libavformat and reads it on a worker thread. The video stream is only demuxed: its access units go, in Annex-B for H.264 and HEVC (converted from MP4/Matroska's length-prefixed form with the [code]h264_mp4toannexb[/code] / [code]hevc_mp4toannexb[/code] bitstream filters), through a bounded queue to a [V4L2Decoder] ([method V4L2Decoder.open_source], [method HWVideoTexture.open_source]). The first access unit after [method open] and after every [method seek] is a keyframe with the parameter sets (VPS/SPS/PPS) in band. The selected audio track is decoded and resampled with libswresample to stereo float at the [AudioServer] mix rate, into a ring buffer that [method get_audio_stream] plays. More than two channels are downmixed (centre and surrounds at -3 dB, LFE dropped); the source layout is in [method get_audio_tracks]. The playback position of that stream is the A/V master clock. All times are media seconds: the stream timestamp minus the file's start time ([method get_start_time]), so the first frame is at about 0. The thread blocks when the queues are full ([member video_queue_seconds], [member audio_queue_seconds]) and is woken when they are consumed; it never spins. [codeblock] var source := MediaSource.new() if source.open("/path/film.mkv") == OK: print(source.get_info()) video.open_source(source) # HWVideoTexture $AudioStreamPlayer.stream = source.get_audio_stream() [/codeblock]

method.name: close
method.description: Stops the thread and closes the file. Close a [V4L2Decoder] reading from it first.

method.name: get_audio_position
method.description: Returns the media time of the next audio frame to be mixed: the time of the last frame mixed plus one frame. Right after [method seek] it is the seek target.

method.name: get_audio_stream
method.description: Returns a new [AudioStreamMedia] that plays the decoded audio. Play it from one [AudioStreamPlayer] at a time.

method.name: get_audio_track
method.description: Returns the selected audio track (index into [method get_audio_tracks]), or -1.

method.name: get_audio_tracks
method.description: Returns one Dictionary per audio stream: [code]index[/code], [code]stream_index[/code], [code]codec[/code], [code]channels[/code], [code]channel_layout[/code] (for example "5.1(side)"), [code]sample_rate[/code], [code]bit_rate[/code], [code]language[/code], [code]title[/code], [code]default[/code].

method.name: get_duration
method.description: Returns the duration in seconds (0 if unknown).

method.name: get_info
method.description: Returns [code]path[/code], [code]format[/code], [code]duration[/code], [code]start_time[/code], [code]bit_rate[/code], [code]video[/code] ([method get_video_info]), [code]audio_tracks[/code], [code]subtitle_tracks[/code], [code]audio_track[/code] and [code]output_rate[/code].

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the last error or warning (a failed seek or an audio track that can't be decoded don't stop the source).

method.name: get_output_rate
method.description: Returns the sample rate of the decoded audio: the [AudioServer] mix rate when the file was opened.

method.name: get_path
method.description: Returns the path given to [method open].

method.name: get_position
method.description: Returns [method get_audio_position] if an audio track is selected, else the PTS of the last video access unit taken from the queue.

method.name: get_seek_target
method.description: Returns the target of the last [method seek] (0 after [method open]).

method.name: get_serial
method.description: Returns the seek count. Video access units carry the serial they were read under.

method.name: get_start_time
method.description: Returns the file's start time in seconds, which is subtracted from every timestamp.

method.name: get_state
method.description: Returns the state.

method.name: get_stats
method.description: Returns counters: [code]packets_read[/code], [code]bytes_read[/code], [code]video_packets[/code], [code]video_bytes[/code], [code]video_skipped[/code] (before the first keyframe), [code]video_parameter_sets_added[/code], [code]video_queue[/code], [code]video_queue_bytes[/code], [code]audio_packets[/code], [code]audio_frames_out[/code], [code]audio_decode_errors[/code], [code]audio_dropped_frames[/code] (before a seek target), [code]audio_silence_frames[/code], [code]audio_buffered[/code] (seconds), [code]audio_position[/code], [code]audio_underruns[/code], [code]audio_frames_mixed[/code], [code]audio_finished[/code], [code]read_errors[/code], [code]seeks[/code], [code]thread_cpu_seconds[/code] (CPU time of the demux thread), [code]serial[/code], [code]eof[/code], [code]state[/code], [code]state_name[/code], [code]last_error[/code].

method.name: get_subtitle_tracks
method.description: Returns one Dictionary per subtitle stream: [code]index[/code], [code]stream_index[/code], [code]codec[/code], [code]language[/code], [code]title[/code], [code]default[/code], [code]forced[/code]. Subtitles are not read yet.

method.name: get_video_info
method.description: Returns the video stream: [code]codec[/code] ("h264", "hevc", "vp9", "av1" or FFmpeg's name), [code]is_h264[/code], [code]is_hevc[/code], [code]is_vp9[/code], [code]is_av1[/code], [code]width[/code], [code]height[/code], [code]fps[/code], [code]bit_depth[/code], [code]profile[/code], [code]pixel_format[/code], [code]hw_decodable[/code] (H.264 or HEVC, 8-bit), [code]annexb_filter[/code], and from the SPS [code]coded_width[/code], [code]coded_height[/code], [code]display_width[/code], [code]display_height[/code], [code]chroma_format[/code]. Empty if there is no video.

method.name: is_eof
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once the file is read to the end (queued data may still be waiting).

method.name: is_open
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] between a successful [method open] and [method close].

method.name: open
method.description: Opens a file, reads its stream information, selects the default audio track and starts reading.

method.name: read_video_packet
method.description: For scripts and tests: takes the next video access unit from the queue and returns [code]data[/code] (a copy), [code]pts[/code], [code]dts[/code], [code]keyframe[/code], [code]serial[/code], [code]sps_width[/code], [code]sps_height[/code] (coded size of an SPS in it, or 0). Returns an empty Dictionary if none is queued yet. Don't use it while a [V4L2Decoder] reads the same source.

method.name: seek
method.description: Drops everything queued and reads again from the keyframe at or before [param seconds]. Decoded audio before the target is dropped (and a short gap filled with silence), so the audio clock restarts exactly at the target. A [HWVideoTexture] playing this source notices the new serial, drops its stale frames and shows the frame at the target. Returns the new serial. Any thread.

method.name: select_audio_track
method.description: Selects an audio track (-1: none). While open, this seeks to the current position, because the queues already hold the old track's audio.

members.member: Decoded audio to keep ahead of the playback position. Set before [method open].
If [code]true[/code], the downmix to stereo is scaled so no sum can exceed full scale (about 7.7 dB quieter for 5.1). Set before [method open].
Video access units to keep queued, in seconds of frames. Set before [method open].

constants.constant: The whole file was read; what is queued can still be consumed. A [method seek] reads again.
